name: agent-guide
body: Agent guide (deck) value: the deck-root coding-agent author reference, delivered as a kalide-owned full guide `AGENTS_KALIDE.md` written verbatim by kalide scaffolding plus a project-root `AGENTS.md` pointer that contains the reference line `Kalide Reference: ./AGENTS_KALIDE.md` (agent-guide-reference). The full guide is a single unbranded, text-only, offline Markdown reference to the current deck/template format; the pointer is author-preserving (created carrying the embedded pointer content when absent, left untouched when it already carries the string, otherwise appended to with the reference line). Both files are scaffold content inert to load/validate/render/serve/list (solution.constraint.agent-guide-unbranded-inert). It is a descriptor of the authoring domain, realising through its containing domain.group.authoring rather than carrying its own `realised-by` edge.
